title: Deliverable launch contract v1
description: Declared artifact contract for one headless non-coding deliverable run. Owner: lib/production/deliverable_launch.py (load_contract validates exactly these fields; tests/production/test_deliverable_launch.py keeps them aligned). Entry point: scripts/deliverable_run.py. Relative paths resolve against the contract file's folder.

kind.description: slides: lib/slides/recipe.py build_deck_from_topic. document: lib/longform/documents/pipeline.py run_document_pipeline (paper or resume, by the brief's type).

inputs.description: Role -> path. slides: optional 'material' (UTF-8 file). document: required 'doc_dir' (holds document_brief.json and dossier.json, or the draft named by parameters.draft). Preflight also checks files the brief names (previous_pdf, template_dir, main_template).

parameters.description: Kind-specific recipe arguments. slides: topic (required), lang, style, max_pages (integer), creative_mode. document: draft (main .tex file in doc_dir to revise), portfolio_policy (explicit trusted portfolio profile, owner-ccf-a; absent preserves generic behavior).

portfolio_policy.description: Document-only explicit trusted-caller portfolio policy; owner-ccf-a requires CCF A conference-tier eligibility. Publication-type recognition (including short/demo/findings/workshop exclusions) is reported separately and does not change the conference tier. Absent preserves generic venue behavior; unknown profiles fail closed in the recipe.

output_dir.description: Recipe workdir; must be writable on its real filesystem (probe file created, fsynced, renamed, removed). launch_result.json is written here.

name.description: slides: the deck model; document: the writer model. Absent: routing default.

endpoint.description: Running Tofu server's OpenAI-compatible endpoint; model routing, keys and accounting stay with the server. Installed only after preflight passes.

deadline_s.description: Wall-clock deadline; on expiry the recipe's abort is set (observed at its abort checks) and the outcome is timeout.

required_tools.description: Extra prerequisites beyond the kind's renderer (slides: Playwright Chromium via lib/slides/readiness.py; document: latexmk via lib/paper/latex_layout.py).

outcome.description: launch_result.json outcome. scored: the recipe reached its own verdict (delivered true/false; a gate refusal is delivered=false with stage/errors). timeout: budget.deadline_s expired. setup_error: a declared prerequisite is missing or unusable as declared. infra_error: storage/renderer-launch/model-endpoint failure under a valid contract. harness_error: unclassified exception (a scored failure). setup_error and infra_error are not measurements.
